messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty triggered INC-76234 · inference-gateway-prod · 5xx rate spike (6.8% over 2m) — auto-page to oncall-rotation
pagerbot: details: region=us-west2, route=/v1/generate, recent p50 latency stable, errors mostly 502/504. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/5xx-spike
oncall-rotation: @pagerbot acked. I'm on it. ETA 2m.
maya: jumping in — looking at ingress logs now. I see a rise in upstream 502s from auth-proxy and a cluster of kvcache eviction warnings around the same time.
tj: if auth-proxy is flapping, fallback routing may help. Can we divert traffic away from auth-proxy pool "apx-auth-03"?
leena: tagging owners — @tj do you want me to kick a route weight change? I can shift 20% to canary pool to reduce pressure.
maya: logs snippet (last 30s):
```
2026-03-17T02:34:12.123Z inference-gw usw2 egress auth-proxy: upstream 502 from 10.32.14.9: read reset
2026-03-17T02:34:12.125Z inference-gw usw2 kvcache: eviction theta=0.98 bucket=7
2026-03-17T02:34:13.009Z inference-gw usw2 request: id=req_9f3a status=502 latency=312ms
```
opsbot: Running quick checks: k8s pod restarts low, cpu stable, network errors on tcp resets to auth-proxy host pool.
tj: leena please roll weight shift now. I also recommend temporarily disabling prefix caching for /v1/generate to avoid cascade on hot prefixes (small perf hit).
leena: rolling 20% route weight from pool apx-auth-03 -> apx-canary-01 now. will monitor.
oncall-rotation: noted customer impact — several enterprise customers in us-west saw elevated error rates. Raising priority to high and notifying success for potential customer comms. @maya can you scope cone of impact (orgs + request ids)?
maya: collecting org list, posting soon. so far I see increased 5xx for orgs: Shopflow Inc, NotePadPro. grabbing sample request ids.
(3m later) leena: route shift applied. 5xx rate dropping to 3.1% (2m window). continuing to monitor for 10m.
opsbot: PD INC-76234 auto-acknowledged -> status: acknowledged by oncall-rotation.
tj: good mitigation. keep runbook open. we'll decide on rollback once stable for 15m.
oncall-rotation: @pagerbot close the customer-impact loop: ping success + support to pre-empt messages to impacted orgs.
maya: +1. posting short summary for incident timeline and request ids. will follow up with root cause if auth-proxy host shows persistent tcp resets.
leena: adding note: we observed kvcache eviction spike coincident with auth-proxy reset bursts — possible hot key or memory pressure on auth proxies.
opsbot: status update: 5xx under threshold, no restarts, no new errors in last 90s.
oncall-rotation: thanks team — keeping this thread open until we have 30m of stable metrics. If stable, we'll resolve PD and file a short postmortem. :thumbsup:
